outcomes.name: Nakshatra Sancheti
outcomes.headline: Commercial Pilot, Cape Town
outcomes.description: Nakshatra studied with Rushabh Sir at Vardhaman Academy and went on to earn his Commercial Pilot License (MEA-L-IR) with Instrument Rating from 4 Aviators in Cape Town, South Africa.

approval_record.evidence: Owner confirmed Nakshatra (an adult) explicitly agreed to his name, photo and certificate being published on the academy site. The certificate's SACAA license number is redacted at the owner's request; everything else on it is shown as issued. Source documents: a Commercial Pilot License (MEA-L-IR) with Instrument Rating certificate issued by 4 Aviators (PTY) Ltd, Cape Town, South Africa, dated 10/11/2026, and a photo from Nakshatra's own Instagram story at 4 Aviators Pilot Training.
